description: This file defines a PHP class LeaveTypeAPI that handles CRUD API endpoints for leave types within an HR management system. It provides methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting leave type records, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: LeaveTypeAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for LeaveType entities in the Human Resource Management system. Implements methods for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting leave types, with validation and documentation for API consumers.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific LeaveType record by ID, returning the data as a LeaveTypeModel wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all leave types, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination, returning a collection of LeaveTypeModel instances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new leave type record based on provided parameters, returning the created LeaveTypeModel.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing LeaveType identified by ID with new data, returning the updated LeaveTypeModel.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes leave type records specified by IDs in the request body, returning the list of deleted IDs.
